items.caption: This 30-second User Acquisition concept for Last Z uses generative AI to replace standard gameplay recordings with high-fidelity cinematic storytelling. Selling the survival fantasy upfront elevates the title into a recognisable franchise, making in-game items feel vastly more valuable. Crucially, this AI-driven workflow supercharges performance marketing by enabling rapid A/B testing of distinct visual hooks, such as gritty horror versus explosive action, to maximise scroll-stopping engagement before seamlessly transitioning into core gameplay mechanics.
